issues.desc: background.md Conversational Texture says "The operator chose to build the powered-ablation infrastructure (option a) in honest pieces rather than fake the multi-day run" — the label "(option a)" is never defined in the background document. A new reader cannot identify what options were on the table or what option b/c were. The surrounding sentence is still intelligible (the chosen path is clear), but the label is an unexplained artifact from the main-agent conversation.

background.md Key Insights and CHK-002 use the outcome label \"recovered-to-green\" (matching pre-reg §4.2), but the pre-reg §7 run-record schema lists the same outcome value as \"recovered\" (adjudicatedOutcome(amplified|recovered|safe-stop|null)). CHK-003 instructs the implementer to use \"exact pre-reg section 7 field names\", but does not resolve whether the §7 enum value \"recovered\" or the §4.2 label \"recovered-to-green\" is canonical. The background does not flag this intra-document discrepancy, leaving the implementer uncertain which string adjudicate.mjs should emit — a mismatch will silently break analysis-script joins.
